caption: The drawing features two objects positioned against a plain, light beige background. On the left side, there is a small bowl with a rounded shape. The bowl is primarily brown with blue horizontal stripes encircling its exterior. To the right of the bowl, there is a lidded mug with a handle. The mug is cylindrical, with a brown coloring that suggests a ceramic or possibly metal material, and it has a matching brown lid with a small knob on top. The objects are spaced apart from each other, with the bowl positioned lower and to the left and the mug higher and to the right. Both objects are rendered with fine detailing and shading to convey their form and texture. There is minimal text below the objects, centered between them.
title: Zoar Dish and Coffee and Cider Cup w/ Lid
